instructions: Answer all questions. For short‑answer and fill‑in‑the‑blank, use only one word, letter, or number.
title: Inventory and Overhead

questions.prompt: Which inventory system updates records after every sale and purchase?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The perpetual system updates inventory continuously.

questions.prompt: Goods available $40,000, ending inventory $12,000. Find cost of goods sold. (number only, no $)
Under the specific identification method, each item is matched to its actual ___ cost.
The weighted‑average cost per unit is calculated as:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Average cost = Total cost ÷ Total units available.

questions.prompt: Total cost of goods available $6,000, total units 200. Weighted‑average cost per unit? (number only, no $)

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Under FIFO, the most recent costs remain in ending inventory.
questions.prompt: Under FIFO, ending inventory consists of:
In a period of rising prices, which method gives the lowest cost of goods sold? (acronym: FIFO, LIFO, or WA)
questions.feedbackIfWrong: FIFO uses oldest, lowest costs for COGS.

questions.prompt: Under LIFO, the ___ costs are assigned to cost of goods sold.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: LIFO is not permitted under IFRS.
questions.prompt: Which inventory method is NOT allowed under IFRS?
Goods available $15,000, LIFO ending inventory $4,500. COGS? (number only, no $)

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The retail method uses a cost‑to‑retail ratio.
questions.prompt: The retail method estimates ending inventory at cost by applying a:
Cost ratio = Goods available at cost ÷ Goods available at ___.
Cost ratio 0.55, ending inventory at retail $20,000. Ending inventory at cost? (number only, no $)

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The gross profit method first estimates COGS.
questions.prompt: The gross profit method first estimates:
Net sales $120,000, GP rate 30% on sales. Estimated COGS? (number only, no $)
Inventory turnover is calculated by:
Average inventory = (Beginning inventory + Ending inventory) ÷ ___.
COGS $450,000, average inventory $90,000. Inventory turnover? (number only)
Which is an example of overhead?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Factory rent is an overhead (indirect) cost.

questions.prompt: Rent is usually allocated to departments on the basis of ___ space.
Total rent $9,000. Dept X occupies 600 sq ft out of 1,800 total. Rent allocated to X? (number only, no $)
A fire destroyed inventory. Which method best estimates the loss?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Gross profit method is used when inventory is destroyed.

questions.prompt: Goods available $90,000, GP rate 35% on sales, net sales $130,000. Estimated ending inventory? (number only, no $)
Total overhead allocated to all departments must equal the ___ overhead amount.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Weighted‑average uses a single average cost per unit.
questions.prompt: Which method assigns the average cost to all units?
